title: Iran's Judiciary Chief MOCKS US sanctions threats: ‘HAVEN’T you already done that?’
text:
Iran's Judiciary Chief MOCKS US sanctions threats: ‘HAVEN’T you already done that?’"

"Mohseni-Ejei said the US has sanctioned Iran ‘since the very beginning of the revolution,’ adding that ‘the repetition of these actions shows that they are LOST AND CONFUSED’
